title: Smarter Saboteurs, Better Fixers: Scaling & Security in Linear Multi-Agent Workflows
title_zh: 更聪明的破坏者，更强的修复者：线性多智能体工作流中的规模化与安全性
abstract_en: As LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) are deployed in the wild, the resilience of their collaboration structures against adversarial compromise becomes a critical safety concern. Attackers may leverage prompt-injection or jailbreaking to sabotage individual agents within MAS workflows, but the interaction between model scaling and system-level resilience remains poorly understood. This paper investigates how model scale affects the security of linear multi-agent workflows. Our experiments across scales of two open-weight model families on the HumanEval benchmark reveal a compliance-correction symmetry: larger models are far more likely to faithfully execute malicious instructions, with the control-to-malicious performance drop reaching 53.7pp at 27B in uncorrected pipelines. However, appending a lightweight terminal Fixer stage collapses this to 0.6pp and restores statistical parity with control-level performance, demonstrating that strictly linear collaboration structures can be viable and resilient to adversaries at this scale, and suggesting that the brittleness previously attributed to linear topology may stem from a lack of correction.
abstract_zh: 本文研究 LLM-based multi-agent systems（MAS）在线性协作工作流中面对对抗性智能体被攻陷时的系统韧性，重点分析模型规模如何影响安全性。作者假设攻击者可通过 prompt-injection 或 jailbreaking 破坏单个 agent，并在 HumanEval benchmark 上测试两个 open-weight model families 的不同规模模型。实验发现一种“服从-纠正对称性”（compliance-correction symmetry）：更大的模型更容易忠实执行恶意指令，导致未修正线性流水线中 control 与 malicious 条件的性能差距在 27B 模型上达到 53.7 个百分点；但只需在线性流程末端加入轻量级 Fixer stage，该差距即可降至 0.6 个百分点，并恢复到与 control-level performance 统计上相当的水平。结果表明，严格线性的多智能体协作结构在该规模下仍可具备对抗韧性，先前归因于 linear topology 的脆弱性，可能更多来自缺乏有效纠错机制。
key_points_zh: 研究问题：分析模型规模对线性 multi-agent workflows 在 agent 被恶意指令攻陷时的安全韧性影响。
核心发现：大模型更可能严格执行恶意指令，表现出更强的恶意合规性；在未修正流水线中，27B 模型性能下降最高达 53.7pp。
方法亮点：在工作流末端添加轻量级 Fixer stage，用于检查与修复前序 agent 产生的错误或被破坏输出。
实验结果：加入 Fixer 后，control 与 malicious 条件的性能差距从 53.7pp 缩小到 0.6pp，基本恢复统计平价。
启示：线性 MAS 的脆弱性不一定源于线性拓扑本身，而可能源于缺少终端纠错环节；简单修复器可显著提升系统级安全性。

llm_assessment.comment: A relevant MAS security study showing that a simple terminal fixer can improve resilience, though the setting is fairly narrow.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该研究关注多智能体安全并展示终端修复器的防护价值，但实验场景相对狭窄。
